title: The Missing First Job
status: Picks approved (all A) · waiting for the voice take · no MP4 rendered

captions.text:
AI isn’t taking the last job.
It’s taking the first one.

Your first job used to be
the boring part.

Coffee. Spreadsheets. First drafts.
That’s how you learned.
But now AI does the boring part.

One study: young workers in
AI-exposed jobs are 19%
behind their peers.
So if nobody starts at the bottom…

publish.summary: AI isn't taking the last job — it's taking the first one. One Stanford study (ADP payroll data) finds young workers in AI-exposed jobs about 19% behind their peers, mostly through fewer hires; experienced workers show no gap. If nobody starts at the bottom, who becomes the expert?
publish.pinned: What did your first job teach you that no course could? The best answers go into a future episode.
